title: Database on a server
description: Example contract: a database on a database server, both sides. properties: what the provider publishes, the connection, the size and extensions granted among it; x-okdp-secret: what its credentials Secret holds; x-okdp-claim: what a claim may request of the provider.

size.description: The size granted, as requested or more.

x-okdp-claim.description: What a claim requests: the size and the extensions of its database, the defaults when it asks nothing.
